title: Kernel driver load from unsigned source or suspicious path
author: Adama ASSIONGBON (SOC & CTI Consultant), https://linkedin.com/in/adama-assiongbon-9029893a
description: Detects unsigned kernel driver load (Sysmon EID 6) or driver load from user-writable path, or revoked/expired signature from a system path. Covers BYOVD and rootkit installation.
